_doc: Task 6K.1 section 13. Four-way verdict for the native WHU East-Asia vector ground truth. Gates were declared before the verdict; every measured value is reported next to its threshold, and no external building count was hard-coded.

measured.identity_source: shp record order (DBF attributes are degenerate)

reason: EA.shp is confirmed as the native manually delineated building footprint map (34085 polygons); the tile mapping is validated (pixel identity on the sampled tiles and exact grid capacity); the vector aligns with the raster labels (mean IoU 0.9505); the native features carry TRUE instance identity; and the VECTOR-vs-PSEUDO relation answers differ by 0.0696 weighted (threshold 0.05) with 0.0524 of native buildings absent from the pseudo view

revised_task6j_attribution.conclusion: Task 6J's J1 failure is not explained by pseudo-instance merging (Merge rate 0.013432269945295998); 0.785 of failures are proposal-model failures on single native buildings, so the proposal-model conclusion of Task 6K/6J is confirmed on native-vector ground truth.

revised: the archived shapefile is a genuine manually delineated building vector map (34,085 polygons) with TRUE instance identity that the semantic raster cannot express
the pseudo-instance limitation is NOT mainly 'touching buildings were merged': measured merge rate is 0.013432269945295998 of pseudo-instances (threshold 0.05)
the measurable deviation is that a share of native buildings is absent from the pseudo view (vector instances without a pseudo match at IoU 0.5: 0.052364516793735834)
the conversion-loss audit of Task 6K stands, but a replacement candidate now exists WITHOUT changing the imagery dataset
still_correct: the semantic-raster to polygon conversion is faithfully reproduced (YOLO re-emulation IoU 1.00000)
the imagery corpus is unaffected and remains primary

split_and_geographic_result.conclusion: val is drawn from the same two whole-area rasters as train and its tiles are interleaved with training tiles, so scene-level leakage between train and val is certain; the test split comes from a separate raster and is spatially disjoint. The split therefore supports random-tile generalization only.
